The '''F-213 Plasma Disruptor''' was a type of [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
